name: MetaBatch
author: TechArk Solutions

sections.description:
MetaBatch helps administrators manage and update metadata across WordPress posts, pages, and custom post types using a structured workflow.

The plugin is compatible with popular SEO plugins such as Yoast SEO and can work alongside them to update supported metadata fields.

MetaBatch does not replace SEO plugins and does not modify their core functionality.

Features

  • Manage metadata for posts, pages, and custom post types
  • Structured CSV-based metadata updates
  • URL-based content matching
  • Supports common SEO-related metadata fields
  • Works alongside supported SEO plugins

SEO Plugin Compatibility

MetaBatch is compatible with Yoast SEO.

“Yoast SEO” is a registered trademark of Yoast BV.
MetaBatch is not affiliated with or endorsed by Yoast BV.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the metabatch folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins menu.
  3. Access MetaBatch from the WordPress admin area.
